name: Bonn open presurgery MRI dataset — FCD type II

cohort.age: patients: scan 12–65 y (mean 28.9); ages binned in participants.tsv
cohort.types: FCD type II (IIa 16, IIb 34 among operated); lobe/hemisphere labelled

format: BIDS NIfTI; ROI lesion masks (85); predefined train/test split (142/28)
labels: Manually drawn FCD ROI masks for all 85 patients
outcomes: 50 operated; Engel at 12 months and latest follow-up (36 Engel IA at 1 year)
checks: Cloned git tree: participants.tsv (170 rows) and value counts; 85 roi files; full text PMC10359264.
pipeline: Lesion-prior benchmark: test MELD Graph or an imaging agent against manual FCD masks, then feed lesions as excitability priors.
key_claim: 85 FCD II patients + 85 controls with manual lesion masks and Engel outcomes; T1/FLAIR only.

evidence.quote: Here, we make publicly available a dataset of 85 people affected by epilepsy due to FCD type II and 85 healthy control persons.
Our dataset includes MRI data from T1 and FLAIR weighted images, manually labeled lesion masks, and selected clinical features.
